So I recently upgraded from an iPhone to an Android and I wanted to transfer my photos over without any third party software(some of which you have to pay for) or my computer. I found a search on google came up with nothing, so I decided my first post would be something some people might find helpful. It's actually really simple.

Step 1: On your android go to icloud.com (more than likely you'll get an error something like "your browser is not currently supported :(" if not skip down to step 3

Step 2: To fix this error simply set the web browser on your android to request the desktop version (for me it was as simple as checking one box but it could differ with browsers.) The option should be in your browser settings under "desktop view".

Step 3: Once your phone browser is requesting the desktop version of icloud it will allow you to gain access to the login page & well, to your icloud if your browser doesn't automatically do it refresh the page and login.

Step 4: Once you've logged on click "photos" all the videos and photos on your cloud will be available to view & download

Step 5: You can select as many files as you'd like at one time and there will be a big blue "download" button on the top right

You're done! you were able to download all of your iCloud photos and videos without any third party apps or software & without a computer B-)
